name: cosigno
description: cosigno — the AI operator that asks first. cosignolabs.com

scripts.build: next build && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs && node scripts/check-vendor.mjs

comments.dependencies: Everything `next build` and the Netlify Next runtime need to RUN lives here — NOT in devDependencies. Netlify (and any host that installs with NODE_ENV=production) skips devDependencies, so build tooling in the wrong bucket makes the whole build fail and every route 500s. Only test-only tools (playwright, vitest) may stay in devDependencies.
